units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 60">Midr. Till. to Ps. LX</cite>, ed. Bub. <he>בשעה שאמר לו יואב הדברים האלו רעשה הארץ נִתְפַּלְּצָה עליהם ונתקפלה תחתיו ונמצא עומד דוד להכותו</he> when Joab said to him (Moab) these words, the earth quaked; it was split around them, and folded itself under his feet, and presently David stood there to smite him (Moab).
